About / Nelli

A littlecloser.

I’m Nelli, a visual maker based in Vienna. I work across photography, moving image, code and research—following whatever form helps an idea feel most alive.

01 / How I look

I collect the moments that sit between places.

My practice begins with attention: the way light changes a street, how a person holds themselves for half a second, or how a landscape alters our sense of scale.

Nelli Space is where those observations meet. It is both a portfolio and an open notebook—a place for finished stories, visual experiments and ideas still finding their shape.

What I’m
drawn to.

Looking
Everyday gestures, natural light, movement, atmosphere and the details that make a place memorable.
Making
Photography, moving image, visual essays, interfaces and small digital experiments.
Thinking
Images, memory and place—and how different mediums can hold the same idea in different ways.
Now
Based in Vienna and open to thoughtful collaborations, visual commissions and interesting detours.
